_meta.purpose: Reserved X-User-Id values for the API suite. User ids are uuids, so the qaapi- namespace (_qa-foundations §10) cannot live in the id itself — traceability lives in this registry and in the qaapi- prefix on every task title the suite creates. Other QA agents must NOT send these ids.
_meta.rule: All destructive assertions are scoped to tasks whose title starts with 'qaapi-' and to these user ids only. No unscoped global mutations.

QAAPI-U2.role: second account — cross-account isolation probes (TC-33): owns tasks/sessions the U1 requests must see as 404

QAAPI-U3.role: clean account — session-lifecycle TCs needing a virgin open/close history (TC-27, TC-29, TC-31)
